name: Twinte Bukkake! Miku
original_name: ツインテぶっかけ!ミク
source:
She should have thought twice before telling her producer she was willing to do anything for her career! 
Before she knows it she's dripping in his sticky, hot cum. 
A short visual novel showing just how far Miku's devotion to work can be pushed. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039792.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在告诉制片人她愿意为自己的事业做任何事情之前，她应该三思而后行！
在她意识到之前，她已经滴在了他粘稠滚烫的精液里。
一部简短的视觉小说，展示了Miku对工作的奉献精神可以发挥到什么程度。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039792.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
